label: Diagram 8.3
caption: Diagram 8.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity
description: The drawing is a vertical section. At the top left is the text "See para 8.5". A thick grey horizontal band is labelled "Floor or roof above" at its left. Beneath it lies an open space labelled "Cavity". The lower boundary of that space is a thin horizontal line, labelled "Ceiling" at its left end. Above this line, to the right of the word "Cavity", is the text "Ceiling surface/product exposed to cavity – class C-s3, d2 or better", and below the line is the text "Soffit of ceiling – class B-s3, d2 or better"; a short vertical line joins the two texts across the ceiling line. To the right of the section is a block headed "NOTE:" stating that the ceiling should meet all of the following conditions, listed a to d: a. Provide a minimum fire resistance of EI 30; b. Be imperforate, except for an opening described in paragraph 5.24; c. Extend throughout the building or compartment; d. Not be easily demountable. A green banner along the bottom reads "Diagram 8.3 Fire resisting ceiling below cavity".
